_readme: Every piece of text ZSB Hub shows. Edit with `npm run text` (live preview) or by hand. {name} is filled in by the app — keep it. **bold** makes text bold. 'where' says where it appears; 'show' tells the text studio how to bring it up.

app.name.where: App name: top bar, window title, tray

app.stage.where: Top bar, next to the name (while in beta)

app.testBuild.where: Top bar, next to the name, on a test build

header.add.where: Top bar: the white main button

trouble.report.body.text: A short summary for whoever is helping you: problem codes, counts, and how each account is clicking. It leaves out tokens, names, emails and IPs.

trouble.sessions.body.text: Where each account is signed in. A session that isn't this hub can be your own browser — or another clicker using the account, which gets this hub's clicks refused.

trouble.sessions.clean.body.text: Earlier sign-ins this hub made (re-imports, logging in again) that nothing uses any more. Each account stays signed in here.

trouble.sessions.onlyHub.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: account with no other sessions

trouble.sessions.failed.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: the site did not answer

trouble.sessions.loggedOut.text: Logged out — log in again first
trouble.sessions.loggedOut.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: account without a login

trouble.sessions.notFound.text: Couldn't tell which one is this hub
trouble.sessions.notFound.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: the hub's own session isn't in the list

trouble.via.unknown.where: Troubleshoot: an address that is not one of the hub's

trouble.everywhere.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: button on an account

trouble.everywhere.done.text: {name}: only this hub is signed in now.

trouble.failed.where: Troubleshoot: a sign-out did not work

trouble.clicks.body.text: Batches the site refused in the last hour, and batches that didn't land. Each one is a minute of clicks lost.

trouble.clicks.ip.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: column (refused with others on the IP)

trouble.clicks.missed.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: column (of the last batches due)

trouble.cause.own.text: Refused on its own — something else may be clicking it. Check Sessions.

trouble.cause.elsewhere.text: Also signed in elsewhere — another clicker is probably using it. Sign it out in Sessions.

trouble.routes.down.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: a connection that is down

trouble.routes.ms.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: how fast a connection answered

trouble.routes.failed.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: a connection that didn't answer the test

trouble.routes.shared.text: Same IP as {names} — they share one limit

trouble.session.new.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: a sign-in that appeared since the last check

settings.auto.desc.text: Accounts on Auto click cases when their case click % is above this, money otherwise. It's checked at every report, so accounts switch by themselves as they level up.

settings.caseValue.desc.text: Each case account works out what its clicked cases are worth from its own reports (the median of its last 15). Until it has 5, it's estimated at 26% of its max case price — $6.60 at $25. Cards mark that estimate "est.".

settings.cleanOldSignIns.desc.text: Logging in again leaves the old sign-in on the site. The hub removes the ones it made itself; it never touches your browser or anything else.

tour.sample.name.where: Walkthrough: name on the sample card

tour.1.text.text: It clicks for your case-clicker accounts around the clock — money or cases — and collects their vaults. Here's a quick look at where everything is.

tour.2.text.text: Opens the real case-clicker login. You sign in yourself; the app keeps the session, never your password. Each account starts clicking as soon as it's added.

tour.3.text.text: How many accounts are clicking out of the {max} one internet connection allows, and their combined income per hour.

tour.4.text.text: Every account gets a card. The big number is its income per hour — clicks, cases (at their measured value) and vault together.

tour.5.text.text: Next batch counts down to the next 500 clicks. Vault shows how full it is — it's collected automatically at the half-way mark.

tour.6.text.text: Balance and tokens from the site, clicks this run, and the two rates that matter: case click % and money per click.

tour.7.text.text: Auto clicks cases when case click % is above {auto}%, money otherwise, and switches by itself as the account levels. Rename, log in again or remove an account from the ⋯ menu.

tour.8.text.text: Plugins add features and turn on or off without stopping the clicker (Missions is already on; Rewards and Monthly pass claim on the accounts you choose). Log shows what happened. Settings has the Auto threshold, the browser panel and more.

tour.9.text.text: A card or banner says what's wrong in plain words, with a code like CC-AUTH-01 and the fix. Troubleshoot has a short report to share when asking for help — no names, tokens or addresses in it.

tour.10.text.text: Add your first account and it starts clicking straight away. The app also sends anonymous usage stats (no names or logins): Settings shows exactly what, and turns it off.

error.CC-AUTH-01.fix.text: Click "Log in again" on the account.

error.CC-AUTH-02.text.text: Login wasn't finished — the window was closed or timed out.

error.CC-AUTH-02.fix.text: Click "Add account" and finish signing in.

error.CC-AUTH-03.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-03 (on the account card, a heads-up)

error.CC-AUTH-03.fix.text: Use "Log in again" on this account before then — clicking carries on meanwhile.

error.CC-AUTH-05.text.text: Clicks are being refused, and this account is signed in somewhere else too.
error.CC-AUTH-05.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-05 (on the account card, a heads-up)

error.CC-AUTH-05.fix.text: Something else is probably clicking it. Open Sessions and sign out the ones that aren't this hub.

error.CC-AUTH-06.text.text: Signed in from a new place.
error.CC-AUTH-06.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-06 (on the account card, a heads-up)

error.CC-AUTH-06.fix.text: If that was you, nothing to do — opening Sessions clears this. If not, sign that session out there and change the account's password on the site.

error.CC-AUTH-07.text.text: Something else is using this account.
error.CC-AUTH-07.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-07 (on the account card, a heads-up after a busy test)

error.CC-AUTH-07.fix.text: While the hub was paused, the account still changed. Another clicker, a script or someone playing it — open Sessions and sign out what isn't this hub, then test again.

error.CC-AUTH-08.text.text: Same site account as another entry:
error.CC-AUTH-08.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-08 (on the account card; the other entry's name follows)

error.CC-AUTH-08.fix.text: Both would click it and get each other's batches refused, so this entry is stopped. Remove it — the other one keeps clicking.

error.CC-MAIN-01.text.text: Set your main account before anything clicks.

error.CC-MAIN-01.fix.text: Pick it from your accounts, or paste its user id. Clicking starts as soon as it is set.

error.CC-SLOW-01.text.text: Falling behind: clicks aren't landing as often as they should.

error.CC-SLOW-01.fix.text: Usually the site or the connection is slow and it catches up by itself. If it stays, open Troubleshoot → Clicks to see why, or copy the report and send it.

error.CC-CF-01.fix.text: Click "Open check" and tick the box.

error.CC-RATE-01.text.text: Too many clickers on this IP (the limit is 20).

error.CC-RATE-01.fix.text: Stop or remove an account, or run a second install on another IP.

error.CC-RATE-02.text.text: The site is rate-limiting this account.

error.CC-RATE-02.fix.text: Nothing to do — it retries by itself. If it lasts, run fewer accounts.

error.CC-NET-01.fix.text: Check the internet connection (on a VPS: its DNS).

error.CC-NET-02.text.text: The site is too slow to answer (timeouts).

error.CC-NET-02.fix.text: Nothing to do — it retries by itself.

error.CC-SITE-01.fix.text: Nothing to do — clicking resumes when the site is back.

error.CC-SITE-02.fix.text: Nothing to do — clicking and plugins pick up again by themselves when the site is back.

error.CC-PROXY-01.text.text: A proxy isn't answering — its accounts are waiting.

error.CC-PROXY-01.fix.text: Check the proxy in Proxy manager. Its accounts start again by themselves once it works (checked every minute).

error.CC-PROXY-02.text.text: A proxy refused its username or password — its accounts are waiting.

error.CC-PROXY-02.fix.text: Fix the proxy's login in Proxy manager.

error.CC-AUTH-04.text.text: An imported account couldn't sign in with its email and password.

error.CC-AUTH-04.fix.text: Check the password (import it again), or click "Log in again" and sign in yourself.

error.CC-API-01.text.text: The site answered in a way this version doesn't understand.

error.CC-API-01.fix.text: Update the app. If it's already up to date, send the report.

error.CC-PLUG-01.fix.text: Turn it off and on in Plugins, or update it.

error.CC-PLUG-02.fix.text: Turn it off and on in Plugins. If it keeps happening, send the report.

error.CC-PLUG-03.text.text: A plugin needs a newer version of the app.

error.CC-PLUG-04.text.text: A plugin's signature doesn't match — it may have been changed.

error.CC-PLUG-04.fix.text: Reinstall it from the Plugins tab.

installer.welcome.text.text:
ZSB Hub clicks for your case-clicker accounts around the clock and collects their vaults.

- You sign in on the real case-clicker page. ZSB Hub keeps the session, never your password.

- Up to 20 accounts can click at once per internet connection.

- Everything stays on this PC. Accounts, settings and logs are kept in %APPDATA%\ZSB Hub.

Next you choose where to install it and how it starts.
installer.welcome.text.where: Installer: welcome page (rebuild the installer to see it)

installer.options.sub.text: You can change both of these any time in ZSB Hub's Settings.

installer.startup.label.text: Start ZSB Hub when I sign in to Windows

installer.startup.desc.text: It opens in the tray, and accounts that were clicking pick up again by themselves after a restart.

installer.tray.label.text: Keep clicking in the tray when I close the window

installer.tray.desc.text: Closing the window hides it next to the clock and clicking carries on. Quit from the tray icon. If this is off, closing the window stops clicking and quits.

uninstall.deleteData.text:
Also delete your ZSB Hub accounts, saved logins and settings from this PC?

Choose No to keep them for a reinstall.
